articles.title: Introducing new session management tools with native, granular controls
articles.summary: Google Cloud introduces new session management tools with native, granular controls to improve security posture and mitigate credential theft and account takeover risks.
articles.detail: The article discusses the new features of Google Cloud's session management tools, which provide flexible options for setting up session controls based on an organization's security policy needs.

articles.title: Best practices for handling cloud reliability incidents
articles.summary: Google Cloud provides a structured workflow to resolve cloud outages, including verifying, investigating, reporting, resolving, and reviewing.
articles.detail: The article outlines best practices for handling cloud reliability incidents on Google Cloud Platform, emphasizing the importance of preparation and having a plan in place before an outage occurs.

articles.title: Scaling Telco Autonomy: Leveraging GNNs with Distributed GraphFlow
articles.summary: Google Cloud announces the introduction of Distributed GraphFlow, a new capability that enables running large-scale graph neural networks (GNNs) at scale.
articles.detail: The article discusses the benefits of using Distributed GraphFlow to automate network operations in the telecommunications industry, enabling autonomous network operations and improving scalability.

articles.title: Introducing Filestore agent volumes: fully managed storage for agent workspaces
articles.summary: Google Cloud introduces Filestore agent volumes, a fully managed storage solution designed to address the storage requirements of agent workspaces.
articles.detail: The article discusses the benefits of using Filestore agent volumes, which provide a simple and scalable way to manage storage for agent workspaces on Google Cloud.

articles.title: Agent Substrate brings high-density, scalable, trusted infrastructure to GKE
articles.summary: Google Cloud announces the availability of Agent Substrate on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), providing a secure-by-default agent execution runtime.
articles.detail: The article discusses the benefits of using Agent Substrate on GKE, which enables running millions of sandboxes with 10x higher density and sub-500ms resume operations at over 500 suspend/resume activities per second.

articles.title: How Precisely transforms user experience with AI agents using Amazon S3 Vectors
